author: MandarinBeef84
body:
I'm MandarinBeef84 (Minecraft Username) and I was banned for excessive chat related infractions. I would like to be unbanned because I want to go back to the community I love on my favorite server. Getting banned for excessive chat infractions is rude, disrespectful, and mainly immature, I deeply regret these actions. I waited 25 days and then appealed my ban, it was denied because I hadn't served my time, now 2 months after my ban I would like you to reconsider me for reinstatement. This extra month has given me more time to realize how dumb getting banned for excessive chat infractions is. If I am unbanned, I will be an active and respectful member in the community and on the server. I have played on this server through two different accounts for as long as I can remember this game and this server means a lot to me. I am again deeply sorry for my actions and something like this will not happen again. I really appreciate you considering me to be unbanned.  

                                                                                                                                                                                         Thank You, 
                                                                                                                                                                                              MandarinBeef84.
